events.hintOverbent: While opening between {from}° and {to}°; pauses when the lid stops

profiles.noCustom: No custom profiles yet. Duplicate a built-in one to start.
profiles.readOnlyNote: Built-in profiles can't be edited. Duplicate one and change the copy; the original stays as it is.
profiles.noSounds: No sound yet — this event will happen silently
profiles.addHint: Click to add, or drag onto any row
profiles.nothingToAdd: Every sound in the library is already here
profiles.randomNote: When an event has several sounds, one is picked at random each time.
profiles.deleteActiveBody: This is the active profile. Spank will switch back to “All Glass”. The sounds stay in the library.
profiles.deleteBody: The sounds stay in the library; only this mapping is removed.

library.dropzone: Upload sounds: drop files or press Enter to choose files
library.dropSub: wav · mp3 · m4a · aac · flac · ogg  Up to 10 s and 5 MB each  Loudness is normalized and leading silence removed
library.dropOverSub: They'll be processed one by one
library.badFormatSub: Convert it to wav, mp3, m4a, aac, flac or ogg and try again
library.truncated: {secs} s is over 10 s, so it was cut to the first 10 s
library.packImportedProfile: Imported sound pack: {sounds} sounds and the profile “{profile}”
library.name: Name
library.noResults: Nothing called “{q}”. Maybe it hasn't been recorded yet.
library.footer: Double-click a name to rename it. Built-in sounds can't be renamed or deleted.
library.emptyBody: The library is empty, so your MacBook has to take every slap in silence. Drop in a scream, or import someone's sound pack.
library.deleteUsedBody: Deleting it also removes it from the profiles below. If it was an event's only sound, that event will be silent.
library.deleteBody: The sound is removed from the library. This can't be undone.

mute.mutedSub: Sounds come back when the rule no longer applies.
mute.activeSub: No mute rule applies right now.
mute.meetingDesc: Mute while another app uses the microphone or camera.
mute.focusDesc: Mute while any Focus is on.
mute.quietDesc: Mute during the ranges below; they can cross midnight.
mute.systemDesc: Stay quiet when the Mac is muted. When off, sounds play even if the system is muted.
mute.focusAsk: {appName} needs to read your Focus status to know when you don't want to be disturbed. It only reads on/off, not which Focus you use.
mute.focusDenied: Permission was denied, so this rule doesn't work. Turn on {appName} in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Focus.
mute.focusUnsigned: This build can't read Focus status (it needs the signed release). The other rules still work.

sensors.unsupportedBody: This Mac has no lid angle sensor, so “Lid opened”, “Lid closing” and “Opening” won't fire. Slaps still work — your laptop will still whine.
sensors.angleUnknownAria: Lid angle not available right now
sensors.stateStopped: Not reading (stops while paused or locked)
sensors.hysteresisHint: After crossing a threshold the lid must move back this far before it can fire again, so wobbling near it doesn't replay.
sensors.cooldownHint: Shortest time between two plays of the same event.
sensors.lidInvalid: These thresholds can't be saved: “Close” must be below “Opening end”, at least twice the hysteresis apart.
sensors.notCalibrated: Not calibrated yet — using default levels. Calibrating makes it more accurate.
sensors.sensitivityHint: Right makes slaps easier to trigger (all three levels go down), left makes them harder. Relative to your calibration.
sensors.preciseDesc: Pauses slap detection while you type, so keystrokes never count as slaps. Needs Input Monitoring; it only notes that a key was pressed, never which one.
sensors.precisePending: Input Monitoring isn't allowed yet. Turn on {appName} in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Input Monitoring. Until then, typing is still filtered by its vibration pattern.
sensors.accelUnsupported: This Mac's accelerometer can't be used, so slaps can't be detected.
sensors.capLidSub: Hinge angle, up to 30 times a second

general.volumeHint: Multiplied with each profile's volume, and follows the system volume.
general.troubleshootSub: Attach diagnostics when you report a problem. They only include your Mac model, macOS version and sensor states.
general.privacy: {appName} collects nothing. No analytics, no account, no server. Sensor readings are processed on your Mac and thrown away; checking for updates only sends the version number.

onboarding.helloBody: A MacBook that can't take a hit. Open the lid, close it, bend it back or slap it — it always has something to say.
onboarding.privacy: Nothing is collected. Everything is detected on this Mac.
onboarding.lidBody: Push the lid down a little, then back up. A sound plays when it crosses a threshold.
onboarding.waiting: Waiting for you to move the lid…
onboarding.noSoundHint: No sound? Check the system volume, or adjust the thresholds later on the Sensors page.
onboarding.noLid: This Mac has no lid angle sensor, so lid sounds won't play. Slaps still work.
onboarding.profileBody: You can switch any time, or duplicate one and make it yours.
onboarding.tapBody: Slap the laptop and it cries out — light, medium or hard. Quick repeated slaps make a combo. Next, 30 seconds to calibrate your hand.
onboarding.tapNote: Uses the built-in accelerometer — no permissions needed.
onboarding.doneBody: {appName} lives in the menu bar, not the Dock. It keeps watching after you close this window — click the little laptop up there to switch profiles or pause.
onboarding.tapSkipped: Slaps are off. Turn them on in Settings › Sensors.
onboarding.desc_destruction: Made of glass: it cracks slowly as you open it, clinks shut, and keep slapping and the whole pane comes down.
onboarding.desc_classic: Opening the lid grinds open a dungeon gate: scraping stone, falling grit, and a combo springs the trap.

calibration.title_hard: Now a hard one (don't actually break it)
calibration.sub_light: Like patting a coworker's shoulder — on the palm rest next to the trackpad.
calibration.sub_medium: Like smacking an old TV that won't behave.
calibration.sub_hard: Like banging the table in protest.
calibration.sub_typing: So it learns typing isn't slapping and won't fire while you type.
calibration.typeHere: Type anything here, e.g. I promise I'll never hit you again
calibration.typeNote: Only the vibration is measured; what you type isn't kept. Recording starts when you type.
calibration.successTyping: Learned how your typing feels. It won't count as slaps from now on.
calibration.tooWeak_medium: A bit too light — that's like your light slap. A little harder.
calibration.tooWeak_hard: A bit too light — that's like your medium slap. A little harder.
calibration.tooStrong_light: Too hard — that's already a hard slap. Try lighter.
calibration.tooStrong_medium: Too hard — that's like your hard slap. Try lighter.
calibration.tooWeak: A bit too light. A little harder.
calibration.timeout: No slap in 10 seconds. Is the laptop on something soft? Try it on a desk.
calibration.unsupported: This Mac's accelerometer can't be used, so slaps can't be calibrated.
